aiPredictive.title: Helix maintenance advisor
aiPredictive.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual narrative of upcoming maintenance risks. The advisor reads only the deterministic maintenance envelope (per-vehicle scheduled items, recent service records, current mileage when available) — VINs, coordinates, place names, IPs, and personal identifiers are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The narrative is informational; the reminders, status badges, and upcoming items list above remain the canonical raw view.

recallWatch.title: Private recall watch
recallWatch.description: Review recent U.S. NHTSA campaigns by model year. This watch cannot check VIN applicability or completion. It posts private cards only, never push alerts.
recallWatch.vehicle: Select a vehicle in the workspace picker to set up a recall watch.
recallWatch.signIn: This private watch requires verified sign-in.
recallWatch.failure: Could not change your recall watch. Refresh and verify your sign-in and vehicle.
recallWatch.confirmModel: I verified this model and model year for the selected vehicle.
recallWatch.confirmProvider: Check the U.S. NHTSA catalog once a day. Send only Tesla, the model and the model year; never send my VIN or driving history.
recallWatch.editHint: Saving replaces the previous watch and clears its saved matches.
recallWatch.applicability: Matches your recorded {{year}} {{model}}. An open recall for this VIN is not confirmed.
recallWatch.basis: NHTSA received the report on {{reported}}. Last checked {{checked}}.
recallWatch.limit: Verify your VIN separately. The public catalog cannot confirm whether this car is affected or whether the remedy is complete.
recallWatch.remove: Turn off and clear recall watch
recallWatch.offline: Reconnect to review your private recall watch.
recallWatch.off: Off. Turn on a watch for your selected vehicle.
recallWatch.unavailable: NHTSA could not be checked. Any visible matches are from the last successful check; none confirms VIN status.
recallWatch.waiting: Waiting for the first catalog check. You can close the browser.
recallWatch.empty: No current model-year matches to review. This does not mean your VIN has no open recalls.
recallWatch.hint: Only recent public model-year matches appear here. Check your VIN separately by entering it yourself on Tesla’s site.
recallWatch.conflict: The watch changed. Review the current setup before trying again.
recallWatch.removeMessage: Stop future checks and delete these private matches? Existing vehicle and service records will not change.

cost.methodology: Annual estimate uses the span between valid service dates, with a minimum of 0.1 years; fewer than two valid dates use total cost. Average cost uses every returned record.

summary.provenance: Counts use all returned maintenance items, before category filtering.
